high_level_description: A single stylized cat in perched sitting pose, centered on a 1600x900 canvas with pale sky background and green grass foreground.

compositional_deconstruction.background: Pale blue sky occupying upper 750px; green grass band occupying lower 150px.

elements.desc: cat body: large light beige oval, vertically centered
cat head: rounded oval, above and overlapping top of body
left ear: small upright triangle, light beige fill
right ear: small upright triangle, light beige fill
left front paw: small rounded rectangle, light beige, clearly separated below body
right front paw: small rounded rectangle, light beige, mirrored position
tail base and gentle upward curl: short horizontal-to-curved beige shape, extending from rear of body
